verses.restored: Judge me, O YHWH; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in YHWH; therefore I shall not slide.

familiar.text: Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.

modern.text: Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.

original.text: לְדָוִ֨ד שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי אֲ֭נִי בְּתֻמִּ֣י הָלַ֑כְתִּי וּבַיהוָ֥ה בָּ֝טַ֗חְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶמְעָֽד

verses.restored: Examine me, O YHWH, and prove me; try my innermost being and my heart.

familiar.text: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

modern.text: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.

original.text: בְּחָנֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה וְנַסֵּ֑נִי צרופה כִלְיוֹתַ֣י וְלִבִּֽי

verses.restored: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

familiar.text: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

modern.text: For Your loving devotion is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.

original.text: כִּֽי חַ֭סְדְּךָ לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י וְ֝הִתְהַלַּ֗כְתִּי בַּאֲמִתֶּֽךָ

familiar.text: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

modern.text: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.

original.text: לֹא יָ֭שַׁבְתִּי עִם מְתֵי שָׁ֑וְא וְעִ֥ם נַ֝עֲלָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א אָבֽוֹא

verses.restored: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

modern.text: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.

verses.restored: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O YHWH:

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: Claims of integrity should not become self-righteousness or a basis for excluding others; the speaker still asks for mercy.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
